name: comp-374
title: Rich Icon Dropdown
description: An outlined button opens a dark dropdown with a New action, two submenus for Framework and Notifications, plus Share, Archive and a red Delete. Icons and keyboard shortcuts sit beside the labels.
use: A toolbar action needs a menu that mixes simple commands, toggles and grouped choices.
avoid: Nested submenus add depth and can be fiddly to reach on small touch screens.
a11y: Radix gives arrow-key navigation, focus-visible styles and real menu roles; purely decorative icons are hidden from screen readers. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded menu appears under an outlined 'Rich menu with icons' button. Rows are left-aligned with small grey icons; New and Delete carry right-aligned shortcut badges, Framework and Notifications end in right chevrons, and Delete is tinted red. Thin rules group the rows.
behaves: Clicking the button opens the menu. Hovering Framework or Notifications opens a side panel with radio choices for frameworks and checkboxes for email and push. Choosing an option updates its state and closes the menu.
customise: The menu items, icons, shortcuts and submenu options are written in the file; the framework and notification values are local state you can rewire.
weight: light: A short menu with two optional submenus; no continuous animation.
